season_1: Exactly one house is founded, by the director's choice of seat riding or by the engine's draw if none is given.

season_loop_default.note: §6: "with probability p_found (default 0.15, halved when 40+ houses exist)". This appears to conflict with the explicit formula recorded under founding_roll_formula below (§10), which has no 40+ houses halving rule. Both are transcribed verbatim; reconciling them is a 9c decision — see rules/CHANGELOG.md.

founding_roll_formula.note: §10: probability is high on an empty map and falls smoothly as land runs out, reaching zero when the map is full. No cap on the number of houses.

region_weights.drift: Shifts each season toward regions with more unclaimed land-adjacent capacity, so settlement moves west as the east fills, without any date driving it.

tag_climate_fit: The current Confederation-band ledger sign doubles the weight of the matching tag when a new house's tag is drawn.
seat_riding_rule: Unclaimed, weighted toward provincial population centres early in a region's settlement and toward hinterland later.
cultural_community: Drawn from a per-region table; Phase 9b authors these with care. Names come from community-specific surname banks and never from real living people.
cadet_foundings: Foundings through partition (§9) do not use the founding roll and can occur on a full map.

initial_stats.note: rank_index presumably 0=Baron, 1=Viscount, 2=Earl, matching rank_probabilities order; not stated explicitly in docs/ENGINE_DESIGN.md — flagged for 9c confirmation. All draws come from the season's seeded RNG and are logged.
